text:
Agent did what could be done without you (updated 2026-11-03):

Unit 1 Mid-term Checkpoints (Canvas 1508956 / 1511530, 1 pt each):
- Still closed. Both locked Oct 7 at 11am, never taken. Only a teacher-side reopen changes that.
- Emailed BOTH TAs from your BYU account (Julia Gazdik, Elise Owens) asking for a reopen. Verified in Sent Items. No reply yet.
- Worth 2 points of 700 (0.3%). Not a grade cliff.

Fixed so this cannot repeat (no action needed from you):
- The real cause was that these two quizzes were the only items in the course with no due date, only a lock date of Oct 7 11am. Every deadline check read due dates only, so they were invisible until after they closed.
- Lock dates now count as deadlines everywhere: the ledger, the nightly Canvas audit, and the dashboard.
- The dashboard now has a "Closing soon, still unsubmitted" list pulled straight from Canvas. Anything worth points inside 3 days shows there until Canvas says it is submitted, even if the ledger claims it is done.
- A newly published Unit 2 checkpoint will now get its own ledger row instead of being mistaken for the closed Unit 1 one. That was the next way it would have been missed.

Your call:
- Nothing yet. If the TAs say only Dr Tennis can reopen it, say the word and I will send him a two-line request. I will not email him without your yes.

Exams (proctored, you take them):
- Exam 2 opens Nov 4, window Nov 4-10, in Canvas with Proctorio. Proctorio is already installed in your Chrome.
- Still unconfirmed whether Exam 2 needs an access code like Exam 1 did. Asked both TAs where it will be posted.
- Practice set ready: HRM391_Exam2_Practice_Set.docx in the hrm391 folder.
